title: Unique Personalized Christmas Decoration Ideas
summary: Discover all the personalized Christmas ornaments you can sell in your store and how to offer them to increase your sales during the season
body_markdown:
[Christmas ornaments](https://www.customily.com/sell-personalized-products/ornaments) are a classic that consistently boosts our annual sales, and offering personalized decorations is a fantastic way to appeal to customers during the holiday season! 🎄


Here are some ideas for products and ornaments you could offer, along with suggestions for customization 💜


## **Ideas for personalized Christmas ornaments**


#### Milestone Ornaments


Milestone ornaments are the biggest driver of ornament sales this season. Baby's first Christmas, an engagement or wedding, a new home, or a graduation are all moments customers want hanging on the tree. Offer templates with space for a name, a date, and a short line like "First Christmas" or "Newlyweds," and let customers choose between text only or a photo upload for a more personal keepsake.


#### Family and Pet Ornaments


Whole family ornaments, showing every household member (including pets), are the single most requested type of personalization. Many customers buy one every year as a tradition, so a template that is easy to re-order with updated names is a strong repeat purchase driver. Offer options for different family sizes, from couples up to large households, and make sure pets can be added as easily as people.


#### Memorial Ornaments


Memorial ornaments, personalized with a name, dates, and a heartfelt message or photo, give customers a way to keep a loved one close during the holidays. These are a smaller category but carry high emotional value and strong word of mouth.


#### Baubles and Monogram Styles


Baubles remain the classic entry point into personalized ornaments. The materials and combinations are endless, including metal and glass baubles, which can be filled or decorated with vinyl. For customers who want something elegant without uploading a photo, offer a monogram style: a single initial paired with a festive font and a small icon like holly or a snowflake. This works especially well on flat ornaments, glass baubles, and wooden discs.


#### Wooden Ornaments


Rustic wooden shapes can be engraved or sublimated with personalized text or designs. Offer shapes like stars, reindeer, or Christmas trees with customized text or family names on them.


#### Table Settings and Decorations


Table runners and placemats personalized with family names or festive quotes can make any Christmas dinner feel special. Engraved or laser cut custom napkin rings with personalized messages or family initials are another simple, high margin option.


#### Display Stands


Customers could choose different pieces to build a Christmas village, a train to the North Pole, or a Santa's workshop to put under the tree. Display stands shaped like Christmas trees or reindeer antlers, used to hang other personalized ornaments or small pictures, are another popular option.


#### Wreaths


There isn't Christmas without a beautiful wreath on the door. Wreaths can be personalized with phrases, family names, pictures, and different materials.


#### Christmas Stockings


It's impossible to think of Christmas without a chimney with stockings. They can be personalized with endless designs, including names, patterns, phrases in unusual fonts, and pictures.


#### Tree Skirts


A custom tree skirt featuring a family name or special message makes for a unique and festive touch beneath the tree. It can be made of paper, fabric, or plastic.


## ‍ **What other products can be personalized for Christmas?**


#### **Apparel**


Personalized Christmas T-shirts, hats, sweaters, and socks with any picture, phrase, or pattern related to the holiday is always a good idea, especially as a present. Personalize holiday apparel for the entire family, and capture a creative photo to remember the occasion. to remember that special occasion.


#### **Advent calendars**


Who doesn’t like receiving an advent calendar and feeling the Christmas spirit since early December? Customers can create custom advent calendars with family names or messages, and even personalize the treats or small gifts inside.


#### **Home Decor**


People like feeling Christmas everywhere and an excellent idea is to offer personalized pillows, throws, blankets, and cushions featuring custom embroidery or printing with festive designs and family names. Door hangers or mugs can also be added to the list of options.

### Frequently Asked Questions About Personalized Christmas Ornaments


**How can Christmas ornaments be personalized?**


**‍** Christmas ornaments can be customized with names, dates, photos, family members, pets, messages, monograms, colors, fonts, and festive illustrations. Stores can offer one personalization option or allow shoppers to combine several elements in the same design.


**What materials are best for personalized ornaments?**


**‍** Common materials include wood, ceramic, acrylic, glass, and metal. The best option depends on the printing or engraving method, the desired style, and the type of keepsake you want to offer.


**Can customers preview their personalized ornament before buying?**


Yes. With a product personalizer like Customily, shoppers can see their names, photos, colors, and other selections appear on the product in real time before placing their order.


**Can personalized Christmas ornaments be sold with print-on-demand?**


Yes. You can connect Customily with a compatible print-on-demand provider to create and sell personalized ornaments without managing production or inventory yourself.


**How are personalized ornament orders fulfilled?**


Once a customer completes their purchase, Customily generates the print-ready file using their personalization choices. The file can then be automatically sent to the connected print provider for production and fulfillment.


**When should I start selling personalized Christmas ornaments?**


It is best to prepare and publish your ornament collection before the holiday shopping season begins. Launching early gives you more time to test your personalization experience, promote your products, and capture shoppers buying gifts in advance.


**What other personalized Christmas products can I sell?**


Beyond ornaments, you can offer personalized stockings, wreaths, tree skirts, advent calendars, table decorations, mugs, apparel, blankets, pillows, and other festive home decor. Creating a coordinated Christmas collection can also encourage customers to purchase multiple products.
